notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has no stance/shapeshift bar surface. Benilla's StanceBar.xml + ui_shapeshift.rs render up to 10 CheckButtons (icon, checked=active form from UNIT_FIELD_BYTES_1, grey not-castable tint, cooldown swipe, UI-Quickslot2 ring, tooltip, click casts the form). In MSUI only UiParentUiLaw models the ShapeshiftBar managed-anchor slot (BOTTOMLEFT of MainMenuBar TOPLEFT +30,45); no renderer, no form list, no click-to-cast, no cooldown display exists anywhere (grep for shapeshift/stance finds only the layout law and spell-error strings).
